jobs.title: Software Engineer / AI Code Trainer (Python, Web, Full Stack)
jobs.location: USA, UK, India, Australia, Ireland, New Zealand, Philippines, Pakistan, Singapore, Mexico
jobs.jd_full:
Who Should Apply

 

We are looking for developers from all technical backgrounds and language specializations. If you write clean code and understand software design, you are a fit:

  • Software Engineers & Computer Scientists specializing in algorithms, data structures, or system design.

  • Full-Stack & Web Developers working with modern front-end or back-end frameworks (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, etc.).

  • Backend & Systems Developers experienced in languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust, or Python.

  • DevOps & Database Engineers familiar with API design, SQL/NoSQL databases, or scripting.

 

Role & Responsibilities

As an AI Code Trainer, you will evaluate model-generated code, author reference solutions, and stress-test AI reasoning across various engineering domains.

  • Code Auditing & Quality Analysis: Critique AI-generated solutions for logic, performance, security vulnerabilities, syntax, and coding best practices.

  • Gold-Standard Solutions: Write clean, production-grade reference code and clear technical explanations for complex programming prompts.

  • Test Design: Build unit tests and edge-case scenarios to evaluate model accuracy and expose edge-case failures.

  • Technical Feedback: Write structured explanations detailing why an AI solution succeeds, fails, or produces bugs.

 

Requirements

  • Software Engineering Proficiency: Strong core fundamentals in at least one major programming language or web stack (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C++, Go, C#, Rust, PHP).

  • Debugging & Code Review: Ability to quickly analyze third-party code, catch subtle logical errors, and evaluate efficiency.

  • Technical Communication: Clear written English to explain technical concepts and code review rationales effectively.

  • Eligible Locations: Resident of USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Pakistan, or Philippines.

 

Why Join Us?

  • $50–$125/hr commensurate with your technical domain expertise and task complexity.

  • Weekly Guaranteed Payouts directly to your choice of PayPal or Payoneer.

  • 100% Remote & Asynchronous: Total schedule control—work whenever and wherever you choose with no fixed minimum hours.

How to Apply

Apply directly on our website at https://codeforai.tech/

jobs.title: Senior AI Enablement Specialist - FE
jobs.jd_full:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role:

Kong's IT team is standing up a new capability: a small, specialized group that goes directly into business functions and builds AI into how work gets done. We call them AI Enablement Specialists — and we're looking for a senior practitioner to help lead that effort.

This isn't an advisory role. You'll be hands-on with the teams you support, building tools that solve real problems and helping people develop new skills they'll carry forward. The scope is company-wide — Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, Customer Success, and beyond. You'll have the autonomy to prioritize where your time creates the most value, and the backing of IT leadership to get things done.

If you've already done this kind of work — transforming how people and teams operate through AI — and you're looking for an environment where you can do it at scale with real ownership, this is the role.

What You'll Do:

  • Spend time inside business teams to understand how they actually work — their tools, processes, pain points, and highest-priority outputs.

  • Build AI-powered workflows, automations, and custom tools that address real bottlenecks and deliver measurable time savings.

  • Help team members develop their own AI skills through one-on-one coaching, working sessions, and structured practice — moving them from early experimentation to confident, independent use.

  • Recognize when a solution built for one team applies to others, and do the work to make it reusable across the organization.

  • Establish a clear framework for tracking AI adoption progress across business units and report findings to IT leadership on a regular cadence.

  • Set documentation standards for the team — every tool, workflow, and lesson learned should be captured so it doesn't live only in your head.

  • Help develop Kong's internal AI governance standards in partnership with IT, Security, and Engineering.

  • Mentor junior team members and interns, giving them hands-on experience and clear feedback.

  • Stay current on AI developments and translate what's relevant into practical applications for Kong's business context.

What You'll Bring:

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in a technical or cross-functional role that required problem-solving across teams and functions.

  • A track record of building AI-powered tools, automations, or workflows that changed how real work gets done — with specific examples you can speak to.

  • Experience helping others develop new technical skills, whether through formal training, one-on-one coaching, or team enablement programs.

  • Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain a technical concept to someone who's never thought about it before, without talking down to them.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and self-direction; you don't need a detailed roadmap to know where to start.

  • Experience working in or with an IT organization, or a comparable role supporting business operations across multiple functions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with AI development platforms and tools such as Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, LLM APIs, custom agent frameworks, or workflow automation platforms.

  • Background in change management, organizational development, or a large-scale rollout that required bringing skeptical stakeholders along.

  • Experience in consulting, solutions engineering, or a client-facing technical role where you had to earn trust and deliver results quickly.

  • Familiarity with the enterprise SaaS tools Kong runs on: Okta, Slack, Google Workspace, Salesforce, Jira, or Freshservice.

  • Experience creating internal toolkits, playbooks, or training programs that outlived your involvement and were adopted at scale.

  • Familiarity with Kong Konnect, Kong Gateway, or API management concepts — understanding how APIs and AI models connect will help you build smarter tools.

#LI-KH1

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.jd_full:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Head of Revenue Operations to join our team. Reporting directly to the SVP Systems & Revenue Operations, this position will oversee the global functions of Revenue Operations, Planning, Forecasting, Sales commissions and regional sales operations and Go-To-Market tools and systems.

This role will collaborate directly with Sales, Marketing, and Finance teams to determine change to GTM strategy & planning, implement performance metrics and influence alignment of all revenue operations.

What you'll be doing:

  • Drive effective revenue opåerational management within the Go-To-Market function

  • Manage revenue growth strategy and execution, operations, enablement and data analysis to support global Go-To-Market initiatives

  • Ensure global alignment across sales functions

  • Collaborate with leadership to drive annual revenue operations planning cycles and alignment across cross-functional businesses

  • Develop and influence new processes and technologies that optimize the path for supporting the revenue growth of the businesses globally across all routes to market

  • Develop and nurture cross-functional partnerships across the entire organization which impact overall growth

  • Partner with leadership to identify strategic priorities and opportunities for the team, overseeing objectives and key results, and ensuring focus is on highest-impact initiatives

  • Partner with relevant GTM Teams and Sales Strategy to leverage performance analytics, influence cross-functional revenue programs and escalate relevant topics

  • Build strong working relationships with executives and key leaders across GTM teams (e.g. product, engineering, marketing, information technology and finance) and influence the goals and priorities of stakeholders whose mission aligns with that of Revenue Operations

  • Build, develop and manage a diverse team of high-performing managers: Build and maintain a world-class, inclusive, diverse, high-performing team by driving effective onboarding, on-going training, retention with a strong remote culture

What you need to bring:

  • 8+ years experience in Strategy, FP&A, GTM Operations and in a People Management role

  • Experience in business, operational leadership roles in a global SaaS Sales environment

  • Experience in crafting strategic vision, making data-driven business decisions, including identifying gaps or business needs, and innovating and scaling solutions

  • Extensive experience in a high-impact strategic role in a fast-growth global organisation

  • MBA degree preferred

  • AI transformation experience preferred within Rev Ops context

  • Management experience and skills with proven experience influencing in a highly-matrixed company

  • Proven record of leading a diverse, high performing team across geographical regions and experience building high-performing, inclusive teams

  • Strong ability to interact and influence effectively with all C-level executives and senior leaders

  • As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

  • Ability to understand key performance indicators, both quantitative and qualitative in a compelling way

  • Strong analytical background; prior experience in a strategic marketing role and/or strategy consulting would be helpful

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your 401k. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.

At Lightspeed, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your skillset, qualifications, experience, and market data. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We reasonably expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of 180 000 to 250 000 USD, depending on the candidate’s location. Additionally, this role may be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. Lightspeed also provides a variety of employee benefits including, but not limited to, medical, dental, wellness, life and disability insurance, 401K plan and match, paid parental leave top-up, and paid time off.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within the United States, and refers to the amount Lightspeed is willing to pay at the time of this posting, which may vary depending on the candidate’s actual location. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Lead Product Management
jobs.jd_full:
About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is seeking a Lead, Product Management to help shape and scale one of our core product areas as Carrot's platform continues to grow. In this role, you'll operate as a strategic driver within the Product organization — owning a significant portion of the product roadmap, setting direction for cross-functional initiatives, and raising the bar for product craft across the team.

This is a highly visible, high-impact role for someone who has already demonstrated strong product judgment and is ready to take on greater scope: shaping strategy, mentoring other product managers, and partnering directly with senior leadership on the initiatives that matter most to our members and business.

If you're energized by solving ambiguous, high-stakes problems and want to help define how Carrot builds products at scale, this role is for you!

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for a key product area, translating company priorities into a clear, prioritized plan of execution
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives, aligning Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial partners around a shared vision and set of goals
  • Serve as a thought partner and informal mentor to other Product Managers, helping raise the bar on product process, discovery, and craft across the team
  • Make and communicate high-judgment prioritization decisions, balancing member experience, business impact, and technical feasibility
  • Partner directly with senior product and cross-functional leadership to shape quarterly and annual product strategy
  • Identify and address systemic gaps in process, tooling, or team practices that limit the Product team's effectiveness
  • Represent the Product team in executive and cross-functional forums, clearly communicating strategy, trade-offs, and outcomes

What Success Looks Like

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Delivered a body of work that measurably improved member outcomes, engagement, or business performance within your product area
  • Built trusted, effective working relationships with cross-functional leaders across Engineering, UX, Clinical, Legal, and Commercial/Customer Success
  • Established yourself as a go-to product thought leader, with other PMs seeking out your input on strategy and process
  • Shaped or improved a core product process (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization) that is now used more broadly across the team
  • Successfully led at least one significant, ambiguous, cross-functional initiative from concept through launch

About You ✨

You likely have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including time at a fast-growing technology company; healthcare or digital health experience is a plus
  • A track record of owning complex, cross-functional product initiatives from strategy through execution
  • Strong product sense and the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints in your decision-making
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align both peers and senior leadership
  • Experience mentoring or informally guiding less-experienced product managers

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in fertility, family-building, or broader digital health benefits
  • Experience partnering with Clinical or Legal teams on regulated or compliance-sensitive products
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled product features or workflows
  • Experience operating in a fully distributed, remote-first organization

Why This Role Matters

As Carrot continues to scale, our Product team needs leaders who can operate with both strategic clarity and hands-on execution. This Lead, Product Management role is central to that effort — helping ensure our roadmap reflects the right priorities, our cross-functional partners are aligned, and our product practices scale sustainably as the team grows.

This is an opportunity to have an outsized impact: shaping not just a single product area, but the way Carrot's Product organization operates as it matures.

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  3. Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes
  4. Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes
  5. Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation:

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $168,000-$198,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

jobs.title: AI Transformation Owner, CRO
jobs.jd_full:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

The AI Transformation Owner drives the end-to-end AI agenda for the field organization, translating emerging AI capabilities into concrete enablement roadmaps, field use cases, and org-level strategy. You will partner closely with product and engineering teams to pilot and scale AI solutions, own the operational transformation plan needed to embed AI into day-to-day field workflows, and establish the governance framework that keeps AI adoption safe, compliant, and aligned with company standards. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from strategy to execution without heavy oversight.

This role reports to the Vice President, Enablement & AI.

What You’ll Do

  • AI Enablement Roadmap: Own and continuously evolve the roadmap for AI-driven enablement initiatives, prioritizing based on field impact, feasibility, and alignment with broader Enterprise AI team and strategy..
  • AI Field Use Cases: Identify, scope, and execute on high-value AI use cases for the field (e.g., deal support, prospecting, content generation, guided selling, skills, change management), working with stakeholders to define success criteria and measure impact.
  • AI Field Champions: build relationships with champions in the field organization to activate power-usage and drive peer-led adoption; track this adoption (e.g., usage, proficiency, behavior change) with our AI Ops Specialist and Enablement Analyst.
  • Ops Transformation Plan: Design and drive the operational plan that turns AI pilots into scaled, repeatable processes, coordinating across enablement, ops, and technical teams to remove execution bottlenecks.
  • AI Governance: Influence and lead governance standards for AI tool adoption in the field, including data usage, risk review, tool vetting, and alignment with company-wide AI policy.

What You’ll Bring

  • Mid-Senior Experience: Several years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related GTM function, with a track record of owning initiatives end-to-end.
  • AI Solutions Experience: Direct experience evaluating, piloting, or deploying AI tools or solutions in a business context, with a solid technical understanding of how they work and where they add value. Act as the field's primary advocate for AI tools (e.g., AI-assisted prospecting, call intelligence, forecasting copilots, RFP/proposal generation).
  • Cross-Functional Fluency: Proven ability to work closely with product and engineering teams, translating field needs into technical requirements and vice versa.
  • Self-Sufficiency: Comfortable operating with significant autonomy — able to define scope, structure ambiguous problems, and drive work forward without needing detailed direction.
  • Organization & Execution: Strong project management instincts; able to manage multiple workstreams (roadmap, use cases, ops transformation, governance) in parallel without dropping details.
  • Innovative Mindset: A builder's orientation toward new technology — curious about what's possible, willing to experiment, and able to separate genuine opportunity from hype.
  • Enablement/Sales Background: Familiarity with field or sales enablement motions (onboarding, tool adoption, content, coaching) and how AI can realistically augment them.
  • GitLab Values Alignment: Ability to work in an all-remote, asynchronous environment, leaning heavily on transparency and collaboration as defined in the GitLab Handbook.

About the team

The Enablement & AI function is part of the CRO organization. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. The enablement organization comprises enablement leads serving the CRO business functions, a centralized content group, AI tech resources, and an operations team.

jobs.title: Former Founder
jobs.jd_full:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

What We're Looking For

Primarily, you like to make great things with passionate colleagues. You are someone that likes to own outcomes, not only inputs. You’re motivated by having responsibility and accountability. You’re eager to ‘do the work,’ big and small.

You’re curious and learning about new technologies, perhaps an early tinkerer with ChatGPT and AI products. You show more than you tell.

You’re motivated by the question, “How can I improve this?” and have a track record of doing so, even in ways adjacent to your role. Much of our current team is made up of former founders and thrive in the level of autonomy at Roboflow. Maybe you had a side hustle in high school or college.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

Who You Are

You tell us! What is your superpower? As a former founder, you might have a background in Engineering, Product, Design, Sales, Marketing (or all of them!). We’re constantly looking for smart, motivated people to work with and can define a role around your strengths.

Within one month, you will…

Spend the first week onboarding in person with your manager (you'll come to our NY or SF Hub!)

Start building a trusting relationship with your peers, and learning the company structure.

Ship a substantial new feature to an end user within your first week

Build your first Roboflow computer vision product (if you haven't already)

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of ~70 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City and San Francisco (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week. Apart from that, we have a flexible schedule that allows you to work collaboratively with other team members and asynchronously when needed.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

The target compensation for this role is $70k-$150k base.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager, Foundry
jobs.jd_full:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a new division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. We operate as a portfolio of small pods, each charged with one product bet, under tight weekly governance. They operate independently, with dedicated resources, separate from the core business on purpose: different pace, different governance, and different rewards.

Our goal is to generate meaningful revenue within 12 to 18 months, so this isn’t an innovation lab. We’re building scaled businesses that customers pay for and retain well, and we’re measuring ourselves on revenue, not activity.

Instructure reaches roughly half of higher education in the United States, connecting a credential network of more than 13,000 institutions. Pair that distribution and data with a fast-moving team that builds leanly, and you have something no competitor has. That’s the opportunity New Markets exists to take.

How we work

A pod is two people: a Founder and a Builder, both hands on, close to the customer. The bet is deliberate: we invest in agent-developer tooling and tokens, not in headcount. An operating team of growth marketing, revenue operations, sales overlay, and G&A supports every pod, so founders stay on building products.

Every pod inherits an underlying platform with common design, development, and deployment harnesses, so no pod rebuilds the plumbing. Each pod runs through key phases with regular checkpoints where a governing board reviews progress or recommends a pivot or kill.

The rhythm is fast and transparent. Investor-style updates go out weekly. Demos and keep-or-kill checkpoints happen twice a month. Transparency is the operating model.

What you will do

You’re the operational engine behind New Markets’ newest product bets. You’ll own the end-to-end go-to-market lifecycle for pod products, from market sizing and early strategy through launch, performance tracking, and the handoff when a product graduates into the core. When a pod proves customers will pay, you make that motion repeatable and hand it to the full seller base. This is a blank-page job: the playbook doesn’t exist yet, and you’ll write it. The role reports directly to the President, New Markets, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Go-to-Market Strategy and Operations leadership.

What you’ll own

You own go-to-market operations across the portfolio, and you’re the voice of the New Markets business in the rooms where commercial decisions get made.

In practice, that means you’ll:

  • Own the end-to-end GTM lifecycle for pod products. Carry each product from market sizing and early strategy through launch planning, field execution, and post-launch performance tracking.

  • Shape the go-to-market approach with each pod. Partner with Pod Founders, marketing, and the sales overlay on ideal-customer definition, pricing and packaging input, channel strategy, and competitive positioning.

  • Design the sales motion. Build the coverage models, pipeline processes, forecasting cadences, and rules of engagement for the first seller cohort on each product.

  • Build the reporting backbone. Stand up and maintain the analytics in Salesforce and Excel that track pipeline health, win/loss, attach rates, average contract value, and renewal trends, and turn that data into insight leadership can act on.

  • Run launch readiness. Lead CRM buildout in Salesforce, playbook documentation, tool configuration, and alignment across enablement, marketing, finance, deal desk, and IT.

  • Own the graduation playbook. Define the criteria and the integration motion for products that complete a pod’s journey, so the full seller base can carry and sell the product without a messy handoff.

  • Be the voice of the business. Translate early-stage complexity into clear, data-backed narratives in planning forums, business reviews, and executive sessions, and support annual planning across capacity, quota, incentive design, and growth roadmaps.

What we expect

  • Blank page to operating framework. You go from nothing to a working system without a lot of hand-holding, then improve it as results and field feedback come in.

  • Rigor under ambiguity. You structure messy, early-stage go-to-market problems, build the analytical frame, and land a recommendation you can defend.

  • Accuracy you stand behind. The insights and reporting you put in front of leadership are right, and you own them.

  • Influence without authority. You move product, finance, marketing, and sales toward a shared plan without managing any of them.

What we’re looking for

  • Five or more years in sales operations, revenue operations, or a related go-to-market function.

  • Real experience supporting new-product launches or emerging-business initiatives, where the playbook didn’t exist yet.

  • Three or more years hands-on in Salesforce, building and maintaining reports, dashboards, and data structures.

  • Advanced Excel, comfortable building models, running variance analysis, and turning raw data into decision-ready output.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive-level presentations. A bachelor’s degree is preferred.

Your first 90 days

  • Month 1. Immerse yourself in the New Markets portfolio, the key stakeholders, and the current go-to-market infrastructure. Understand where each product sits in its lifecycle and find the most pressing operational gaps.

  • Month 3. Establish a clear view of performance across active pods: pipeline health, coverage, and leading indicators. Build or refine the reporting framework in Salesforce and Excel, and set a recurring operating rhythm with product and sales leadership.

  • Month 6. Own and drive the go-to-market motion for at least one pod through a checkpoint. Deliver an integration-readiness recommendation for any product approaching graduation, and present a prioritized roadmap for improving New Markets go-to-market operations to senior leadership.

This role isn’t for everyone

Anti-patterns. You should probably pass if:

  • You need an established playbook and a stable process to operate inside. Here you build the playbook.

  • You’re uncomfortable being measured on the accuracy of your numbers and the clarity of your recommendations.

  • You’d rather own a single, well-defined process than the whole messy go-to-market surface across a portfolio.

  • A predictable, slow-changing scope is what you want. The portfolio shifts as pods move through their checkpoints.

Compensation

Base pay is market-competitive. You’ll be paid fairly against the market for the work, so you’re not taking a pay cut to be here. But the base is the floor, not the prize.

The real value is the upside you drive. As part of the operating team, you share in a cash bonus pool tied to portfolio milestones across pods. Targets are set as pods launch, so you’ll know what the portfolio is running at.

The upside is asymmetric, and it’s earned, not granted. There’s a hard floor: below a threshold level of attainment, milestone payouts don’t trigger at all. Above it, hitting and stretching past your targets pays meaningfully. This is built to be the kind of outcome that changes your trajectory, not a routine bonus. The rewards go to the people who build something customers pay for. They don’t reward effort, tenure, or proximity.

What this means in plain terms. Real ownership. Real accountability. Real upside for the people who build a business, and very little for those who don’t. If that trade excites you, you’re the person we’re looking for. If it worries you, trust that instinct.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

This is a remote position.

Role overview
Our client is an Australian technology company whose AI voice agent platform answers and handles phone calls for businesses in Australia and New Zealand.
As a Product Analyst, your responsibility is to research the AI voice agent market and turn it into clear, build-ready feature documents for our client's development team. This role is the bridge between the market and the product. You will study what competitors offer, analyse what the platform should build next, and write specifications the CTO can act on. The Founder & CEO makes final decisions on what gets built.
Business owners create their own AI agents that can answer questions, book appointments, collect caller details, send SMS messages and transfer calls to staff. The platform is fully self-serve: customers set up and manage their agents, and handle any escalated calls themselves. The platform is built on its own technology stack using leading speech and language AI models, and is designed to work across industries.
Key Responsibilities
Market and competitor research
  • Identify and track AI voice agent and call-handling platforms, globally and in Australia and New Zealand.
  • Sign up for competitor free trials, build test agents and call demo numbers to experience their products first-hand.
  • Monitor competitor feature releases, pricing changes, integrations and new market entrants.
Feature analysis
  • Break down how competitors design and deliver specific features, including user flows, settings and limitations.
  • Assess which features are standard expectations and which could set the platform apart.
  • Research third-party integrations (CRMs, calendars, booking systems, helpdesks) and how they connect to voice agent platforms.
Feature documentation
  • Write clear, structured feature specification documents using the client's standard format.
  • Present feature documents to the Founder & CEO for review and approval.
  • Hand approved specifications to the CTO and answer the development team's questions about them.
  • Keep a prioritised feature backlog up to date.
Platform insight
  • Review anonymised call transcripts and recordings to spot where agents struggle or callers get confused.
  • Analyse platform usage data, such as feature adoption and drop-off during agent setup.
  • Review support tickets and cancellation feedback for recurring issues and feature requests.
Product quality
  • Test new features once built against the approved specification and report gaps.
  • Help maintain product documentation and help-centre content for new features.

Requirements

Essential

About us

Passion for food. Hunger for tech. We make METRO digital.

Job Description

TOM transformation:

TOM describes the desired state of our organization’s operational capabilities and functions. It provides a vision for the future state of the business, explaining how the company needs to operate to deliver its strategy and achieve its business goals efficiently. The TOM outlines how various elements like processes, technology, governance, and people should interconnect and interact to deliver value. It serves as a roadmap for implementing organizational change and transformation.

At METRO, we are progressing on our digitalization journey, and as part of the transformation enabled by the TOM ecosystem, we are introducing new leadership roles to bring this vision to life.

How will you make an impact?

We are seeking a skilled Senior Project Manager to lead strategic and complex initiatives within our digital transformation portfolio. In this role, you will bridge technology and business, deliver impactful outcomes while mentoring other project managers and promoting best practices. You will be instrumental in orchestrating project success across platforms and contributing to our enterprise‑wide digital agenda.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform Experience & AI
jobs.jd_full:
Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Senior Product Manager for Platform Experience & AI in our Tel Aviv office, you’ll own how thousands of advertisers experience Realize, Taboola’s performance advertising platform, every day - in the product, through ABBY, our AI assistant, and increasingly through AI agents that operate Realize on the advertiser’s behalf via our public MCP server.

We are hiring a consumer product builder for a platform job. Realize is used by everyone from first-time SMB advertisers to global agencies, and the bar for it is consumer-grade: intuitive at first touch, effortless at scale, and smart enough to guide people to results. You’ll lead three connected surfaces - the core platform experience, ABBY, and the agentic (MCP) layer - together with a peer product lead in our Emerging Products Domain group. You’ll work with UX, R&D, Data Science, Product Analysts, Product Marketing and Business teams to make Realize the platform advertisers want to use, not just have to.

To thrive in this role, you’ll need:

  1. Proven B2C product experience: 6+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping consumer products used by millions of people and owning outcomes like activation, engagement and retention. This is the core of the role.
  2. UX/UI craft at scale: You have led the experience of a high-traffic product, can critique a flow in detail, prototype your own ideas, and partner with design as a peer rather than a client. You know what “simple at scale” costs and how to get there.
  3. Strong product sense: You form a sharp point of view on what to build and what not to, back it with data and user insight, and make the call. You own a domain end-to-end - vision, roadmap, alignment across R&D, Design, Data Science and Business, and measurable outcomes.
  4. AI-native ways of working: You use AI tools every day as part of how you do product work - discovery, prototyping, analysis, writing - and you understand how LLM-based products behave well and badly. Building with AI is not new to you; it is how you work.
  5. Data and experimentation fluency: Comfortable designing and reading A/B tests, working with product analytics, and turning data into decisions and clear narratives for stakeholders.
  6. Communication that moves teams: Able to align global cross-functional partners and senior stakeholders behind a shared direction, and to make complex things simple in writing and in the room.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience mentoring or managing product managers
  • Ad-tech or performance-marketing experience, especially on self-serve ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads or similar) or products serving SMB advertisers
  • Experience shipping LLM-based assistants, copilots or agents; familiarity with MCP or other agent protocols
  • Experience with self-serve SaaS growth: onboarding, activation loops, product-led growth
  • Design, front-end or user-research background
  • Experience in a two-sided marketplace or platform business

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Bring consumer-grade craft to Realize: Own the end-to-end advertiser journey - onboarding, campaign creation, reporting and in-product guidance - and turn complex advertising workflows into experiences that feel obvious. You’ll set the UX bar for a platform used by thousands of advertisers at every level of sophistication.
  • Lead ABBY, our AI assistant: Define what ABBY does, where it shows up and how far it goes - from proactive insights and recommendations to taking action on the advertiser’s behalf. Make the product feel like it has a smart operator inside it.
  • Make Realize agentic: Shape how advertisers and their AI agents operate Realize from outside the UI through our public MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Decide what the platform exposes, how it protects advertisers, and how the agent experience and the in-product experience reinforce each other.
  • Design for activation and retention at scale: Own the metrics that matter - time to first campaign, activation, feature adoption, retention and incremental spend - and move them through large-scale A/B tests and fast iteration.
  • Raise the bar for AI-native product work: Use AI tools daily to research, prototype, analyze and spec, and bring that way of working to the team around you.

Why Taboola?

If you ask Taboolars what they love about working here, they’ll tell you that they’ve been empowered to realize their full potential while growing and learning from and with smart and talented people. They’ll also share more about:

  • Adam Singolda, Taboola Founder and CEO: “You can copy anything from another business but you can’t copy a company’s culture.”
  • Well-being: Competitive benefits and well-being programs tailored to the region, including comprehensive health benefits, a fully stocked kitchen, and location-specific perks.
  • Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work schedule with 3 days in-office, with an option to come in more often if desired.
  • Work with some of the biggest names: Our publisher partners include Yahoo, Conde Nast, Fox Sports, NBCU, ESPN, CBS, and E! Online. Our advertiser clients include Wells Fargo, Honda, Pinterest, and Expedia.

Ready to realize your potential?

Taboola is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity in all forms. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and believe such an environment is critical for success. Employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Learn more about #TaboolaLife on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X, YouTube, & the Taboola Life Blog.

About Taboola

Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.
